item.title: American missionary Kevin Rideout released after 9 months in captivity in Niger
item.description: Kevin Rideout, an American missionary kidnapped in Niger last October, has been released and will reunite with his extended family.

item.title: How clocks, calendars and time zones came to be
Trump says U.S. warship's 9-month deployment 'not nearly long enough'
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln has been deployed for nearly nine months and is expected to be replaced in the Middle East.

item.title: Warren demands answers from RFK Jr. on 'calamitous' cyclosporiasis outbreak response
item.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren wrote to HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. seeking more information about the administration's 'calamitous' response to the outbreak.
